description:
Update scripts/create-pr.mjs's stack PR title validation to require a
`[REFACTOR: <Technique>]` bracket exactly when the PR's declared
Review Lane is `refactor`, and to forbid it otherwise.
Review claim: Approve extending `STACK_PR_TITLE_PATTERN` with an
optional `[REFACTOR: <Technique>]` group, and adding a Review-Lane
cross-check to `assertValidStackPrTitle`, with no change to title
shape checks for the other five lanes.
Review lane: policy
Safety invariant: The added regex group is optional
(`(?:\[REFACTOR: [^\[\]\r\n]{2,80}\])?`), so every title accepted
today still matches; the new semantic check only fires when the
declared Review Lane is exactly `refactor`. Verify by re-running
`node scripts/test-create-pr-stack-workflow.mjs` and confirming every
existing title-format test case still passes unchanged in addition to
the new refactor-lane cases.
Slice rationale: Second workflow in a 3-step chain (the prior slice
stated the rule, this one enforces the title, a separate diff-atomicity
check comes after) --
title-format enforcement and diff-content enforcement are different
review claims and ship as separate PRs.
Architectural effect: `assertValidStackPrTitle` changes from a
single-argument shape check to a two-argument shape-plus-lane check.
Its one call site now computes `reviewLane` from the already-parsed
PR body once (reusing the exact `getReviewMetadata` import already
present in this file from the earlier refactor-dead-symbol slice) and
passes it to both `assertNoStackAtomicityBlockers` (already threaded)
and `assertValidStackPrTitle`.
Goal: Land the enforcement so `node scripts/test-create-pr-stack-workflow.mjs` passes with new refactor-lane title cases.
Motivation: A documented-but-unenforced convention drifts. Stacked PR
creation is the one place that already gates on title shape, so this
is the natural enforcement point.
Alternative considerations: Enforcing the bracket for every PR
(stacked or not) was rejected -- today's title-format check only
applies to stacked PRs (`isStackedPrContext`), and this change
preserves that existing scope rather than expanding it. Making the
bracket content a closed enum matched against the technique catalog
was rejected -- the catalog's own text says "if none fits, say so
explicitly... rather than picking the nearest wrong name," so the
bracket stays free text validated only for shape.
Implementation details: |
  In scripts/create-pr.mjs, the current title-pattern and validator
  (near line 208) read:
      const STACK_PR_TITLE_PATTERN = /^\[[^\[\]\r\n]{3,80}\]\([1-9]\d*[a-z]?\)(?:\s+\S.*)?$/;
      function isStackedPrContext(baseBranch, mergifyState) {
        return mergifyState.managed || !TRUNK_BRANCHES.has(baseBranch);
      }
      function assertValidStackPrTitle(title) {
        if (STACK_PR_TITLE_PATTERN.test(title.trim())) return;
        throw new Error(
          [
            'Stack PR titles must start with a shared idea and exactly one slice index.',
            'Use: [Graph Blanking](1) Preserve selected graph while loading',
            'Use lettered replacements when one published slice must split: [Graph Blanking](3a) Split follow-up slice',
          ].join('\n'),
        );
      }
  Replace `STACK_PR_TITLE_PATTERN` with:
      const STACK_PR_TITLE_PATTERN = /^\[[^\[\]\r\n]{3,80}\]\([1-9]\d*[a-z]?\)(?:\[REFACTOR: [^\[\]\r\n]{2,80}\])?(?:\s+\S.*)?$/;
      const REFACTOR_TAG_PATTERN = /\[REFACTOR: [^\[\]\r\n]{2,80}\]/;
  Replace `assertValidStackPrTitle` with a two-argument version:
      function assertValidStackPrTitle(title, reviewLane) {
        const trimmed = title.trim();
        if (!STACK_PR_TITLE_PATTERN.test(trimmed)) {
          throw new Error(
            [
              'Stack PR titles must start with a shared idea and exactly one slice index.',
              'Use: [Graph Blanking](1) Preserve selected graph while loading',
              'Use lettered replacements when one published slice must split: [Graph Blanking](3a) Split follow-up slice',
              'Refactor-lane PRs add a technique tag right after the slice index: [Graph Blanking](2)[REFACTOR: Move Method] git primitives -> repair_body.py',
            ].join('\n'),
          );
        }
        const hasRefactorTag = REFACTOR_TAG_PATTERN.test(trimmed);
        if (reviewLane === 'refactor' && !hasRefactorTag) {
          throw new Error(
            [
              'Review Lane is "refactor" but the title has no [REFACTOR: <Technique>] tag.',
              'Name the technique from the catalog in the review-compression skill file\'s Naming the Technique section.',
              'Example: [Graph Blanking](2)[REFACTOR: Move Method] git primitives -> repair_body.py',
            ].join('\n'),
          );
        }
        if (reviewLane !== 'refactor' && hasRefactorTag) {
          throw new Error(
            `Title has a [REFACTOR: ...] tag but Review Lane is "${reviewLane || '(missing)'}", not refactor. Either set Review Lane to refactor or drop the tag.`,
          );
        }
      }
  Find the one call site (inside the existing
  `if (isStackedPrContext(args.base, mergifyState)) { assertValidStackPrTitle(args.title); ...`
  block, a few lines below the existing
  `assertNoStackAtomicityBlockers(args.base, mergifyState, diffText, getReviewMetadata(body).reviewLane);`
  line). Above that `assertNoStackAtomicityBlockers` call, add:
      const reviewLane = getReviewMetadata(body).reviewLane;
  and change that line to reuse the variable:
      assertNoStackAtomicityBlockers(args.base, mergifyState, diffText, reviewLane);
  Then change the call site inside `isStackedPrContext(...)` from
  `assertValidStackPrTitle(args.title);` to
  `assertValidStackPrTitle(args.title, reviewLane);`.
  `getReviewMetadata` is already imported in this file
  (`import { getPrAtomicityBlockers, getPrBodyWarnings,
  getReviewMetadata, validatePrBody } from './validate-pr-body.mjs';`)
  -- no new import is needed.
Non-goals: No changes to `scripts/lint-pr-diff-atomicity.mjs` or the
  skill docs in this workflow (workflow 1 already landed the docs;
  workflow 3 is the separate diff-atomicity check). No change to
  title-format enforcement for the other five Review Lanes -- their
  titles must keep validating exactly as before. No change to
  non-stacked PR title handling (still unenforced, matching today).
Layer: domain
Feature state: active
Files:
- scripts/create-pr.mjs
Change types:
- scripts/create-pr.mjs: modify
Acceptance criteria:
- `node scripts/test-create-pr-stack-workflow.mjs` exits 0.
- A stacked PR with `Review Lane: refactor` and no `[REFACTOR: ...]` bracket in its title is rejected with an error mentioning the technique catalog.
- A stacked PR with a `[REFACTOR: ...]` bracket but `Review Lane` other than `refactor` is rejected with an error saying to fix the lane or drop the tag.
- A stacked PR with `Review Lane: policy` (or any non-refactor lane) and a plain `[Tag](N) description` title (no bracket) is still accepted, unchanged from today.
